schema_version: v0 — component-charter shape; migrates into the intention envelope when MAP.md Q6 lands
what: The cairn device's published fixture bus: scratch_bus(prefix) yields a BusDevice over a scratch transit table that drops when the context exits, and bus_shim(bus, heartbeat) builds the bus's own shim over it. A proof outside the cairn device that needs a bus of its own, with a real store under it and nobody live listening, reaches the bus machine through this module and nothing else.
why: Measured 2026-11-11: the build inspector's encapsulation_holds sieve redded seven sites in five proofs (codemother's test_charter_held.py and test_codemother.py; tester's test_a_hollow_seal_is_announced.py, test_the_seal_announces_itself.py and test_the_tester_takes_its_reply.py), each importing cairn.devices.cairn.machines.bus.bus or .shim for a scratch bus and its shim. Their teeth need what only a bus of their own gives: a fixture seal that live codemother never hears, a store that flush writes and undelivered reads, and codemother genuinely unwired. RULE 1 admits a reach into a device only through a tool it publishes, so the cairn device publishes the fixture.
entry: Born 2026-11-11 under ticket a695aee4d89b: two functions over BusDevice.scratch and the BusShim constructor, no new behaviour.
invoke: from cairn.devices.cairn.tools.scratch_bus import scratch_bus; then with scratch_bus.scratch_bus('prefix') as bus: and roster.hold(scratch_bus.bus_shim(bus, roster)). Prove: bin/cairn test cairn/devices/cairn/tools/scratch_bus/proofs/test_a_proof_gets_a_bus_of_its_own.py
state_and_history: A TOOL HOLDS NO STATE OF ITS OWN (Law 6): each bus it yields lives on a scratch table that drops on exit. Its voyages ride history.json and state.json beside this charter.
proof: proofs/test_a_proof_gets_a_bus_of_its_own.py — a post on the yielded bus is read back and stands undelivered with no shim wired, flush empties the ring into the store, the scratch table is gone after exit, bus_shim returns the bus's own shim over that bus, and the encapsulation sieve admits an outside import of this module while still redding one of the bus machine.
gates: Import gate — encapsulation_holds in build_inspector admits a reach into the cairn device through this tool because this charter says published_by_device. Seal: the tester seals the proof into validations/.
falsifier: Red if a post on the yielded bus does not stand in its store, if the scratch table outlives the context, if bus_shim builds anything but the bus's own shim, or if this charter stops declaring published_by_device.
learns: It does not; it is a fixture, deliberately dumb — the bus's behaviour is the bus machine's to change, and this tool only hands it out.
how_it_learns: It does not; it is a fixture, deliberately dumb — the bus's behaviour is the bus machine's to change, and this tool only hands it out.
traces_to: RULE 1 (encapsulation — a device's public interface is the bus plus any client tool it publishes)
Law 6 (a tool has users; the scratch table is the proof's for the length of the context)
Law 8 (a fixture bus keeps a fixture seal out of the live codemother)
owner: None of its own — a tool has users (Law 6): the proofs of codemother and tester that need a bus of their own. Its code is held by the cairn device, which publishes it; CC gates writes to that code and its proofs.
